title: Built in the open for the ummah
summary: {appName} is source-available on GitHub for personal and educational use. You may use, modify, and redistribute it — with credit and a link to munibtracker.app. It may not be sold or used commercially.

source.title: Source on GitHub
source.body: Browse the monorepo — Expo app (phone + TV), NestJS API, admin console, and this marketing site — in one place.

license.title: Clear license
license.body: Non-commercial use, modification, and redistribution with required attribution.

fork.title: Fork & improve
fork.body: Adapt for your community’s non-commercial needs — keep the credit and the link.

contribute.title: Contribute
contribute.body: Code, docs, translations, and careful content corrections are all welcome.

items.personalUse: Use the app and source for personal worship, study, and education
items.modify: Modify the code and share your changes non-commercially
items.redistribute: Redistribute copies with the license, NOTICE, and marketing-site credit
items.contribute: Contribute bug fixes, translations, docs, and content corrections

notPermitted.heading: What is not allowed

items.sell: Sell the app, a fork, or a customized version as a product
items.commercial: Use the project as part of a commercial product or paid service
items.stripAttribution: Strip attribution or remove the link to munibtracker.app
items.inventScripture: Invent or AI-generate religious scripture for inclusion in the app
items.solicitMoney: Solicit or accept money in the name of {appName} (no sponsorship, funding, or donations at this time)

notPermitted.legal: Full legal text: <licenseLink>{license}</licenseLink>. Attribution requirements live in our <notice>NOTICE</notice> file on GitHub.

attribution.heading: Required attribution
attribution.body: Anyone who uses, modifies, or redistributes {appName} must keep the license and NOTICE, credit {appName}, and include a visible link to munibtracker.app.

noFunding.heading: No sponsorship or donations
noFunding.notice: {appName} does not currently accept sponsorship, funding, or donations. Do not send money to anyone claiming to collect funds on behalf of {appName}.
noFunding.body: There is no official Patreon, GitHub Sponsors, crypto wallet, or payment link for this project at this time. Help by contributing code, docs, translations, or careful content corrections — see <contributing>CONTRIBUTING.md</contributing>.

contribute.heading: How to contribute
contribute.body: Start with the <guide>contributing guide</guide>. Good first steps: docs typos, UI polish, translations, and content accuracy reports. See everyone who has helped on our <contributors>Contributors</contributors> page. Religious datasets remain under their own licenses — listed on <credits>Credits</credits>.
